name: restaurant-availability-watch
title: Restaurant Availability Watch
description: Check reservation-slot availability and waitlists on OpenTable and Resy pages protected by DataDome - each slot checked per venue, date and party size for concierge and dining-alert services.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Restaurant Availability Watch
input.description: Check reservation-slot availability and waitlists on OpenTable and Resy pages protected by DataDome - each slot checked per venue, date and party size for concierge and dining-alert services.

change_threshold.title: Change threshold
change_threshold.description: SimHash bit distance above this counts as changed (0 = any difference, 3 default, 10+ only major rewrites).

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

party_size.title: Party size
party_size.description: Dining party size used for availability checks.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
